activity.notes: Hone Tūhawaiki led Ngāi Tahu in Murihiku from Te Whakataupuka's death, probably in 1835, until his own death in 1844. The scope is the southern Ngāi Tahu community rather than all Māori; the initial year is explicitly approximate.
